hero.subtitle: Sign in with your Ethereum wallet using EIP-4361 — nonce, personal_sign, JWT tokens.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: MetaMask is not OAuth. The API implements Sign-In with Ethereum (SIWE / EIP-4361): issue a one-time nonce, have the wallet sign a structured message, verify the signature, upsert the user by address, and return the same JWT contract as password login. New users get a random display name (e.g. Fearful Bear).

console.title: Configuration
console.description: No Developer Portal app is required. Align METAMASK_DOMAIN / METAMASK_URI with the host and origin used in the client SIWE message, and allow the chain IDs your users will sign on.

api.title: API contract
api.description: Two POST endpoints — no browser redirect callback.

client.title: Browser sample
client.description: Minimal MetaMask flow. Domain, URI, chain ID, and statement must match server config.

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: The lowercased Ethereum address is stored as metamaskId. Email is synthetic (address@users.noreply.metamask.local). Display names are random adjective+noun pairs generated only on first login.
